title: Wizardry: Llylgamyn Saga
native_title: ウィザードリィ リルガミン サーガ
overview:
The real thing is no pushover! The origin of every fantasy RPG is here.

The first three Wizardry scenarios come together in one package: Proving Grounds of the Mad Overlord, Knight of Diamonds and Legacy of Llylgamyn. Form a party of adventurers and lead them down into dangerous 3D dungeons to battle monsters. The rules follow the originals, and the game saves automatically, so the fear of losing a character for good is always with you.

- Three classic scenarios with 3D dungeon graphics
- A six-level bonus dungeon
- Museum Mode for viewing every item and monster
- Switch messages between Japanese and English at any time

本物はヌルくない！
すべてのファンタジーRPGの原点がここにある。
